titleEn: Absence Makes the Heart Grow Fonder

items.promptEn: After a month studying away, May looked forward to calls with her mother more than before.
items.promptZh: 阿美到外地讀書一個月後，比以前更期待與母親通話。

options.text: May missed her mother more while they were apart—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
options.reasonZh: 分開後更期待通話，顯示掛念增加。

options.text: May forgot her mother while they were apart—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
options.reasonZh: 原文是更期待通話，不是忘記母親。

options.text: May and her mother had not spent any time apart—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
options.reasonZh: 原文清楚說阿美到外地讀書一個月。

options.text: Every student misses their mother more after moving away—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
options.reasonZh: 一人的感受不能代表所有學生。

items.promptEn: While her father was away for two weeks, Lok realised she valued cooking with him more.
items.promptZh: 父親出差兩週後，樂樂發覺自己比平日更珍惜與他一起煮飯。

options.text: Lok valued time with her father more during his trip—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
options.reasonZh: 分開令樂樂更珍惜相處時間。

options.text: Lok stopped caring about time with her father during his trip—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
options.reasonZh: 與更珍惜相處的事實相反。

options.text: Lok learned to cook only after her father returned—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
options.reasonZh: 原文沒有說她何時學會煮飯。

options.text: The trip made everyone in the family a better cook—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
options.reasonZh: 諺語談感情，不是全家廚藝。

items.promptEn: After spending the summer apart from his friend, Fung was more excited than before to meet again.
items.promptZh: 阿峰與好友分開過暑假後，見面時比以前更興奮。

options.text: Fung welcomed the reunion more eagerly after time apart—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
options.reasonZh: 先分開，重聚時更興奮，符合諺語。

options.text: Fung felt no different about the reunion after time apart—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
options.reasonZh: 原文有「比以前更興奮」的變化。

options.text: Fung had spent the whole summer beside his friend—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
options.reasonZh: 原文是整個暑假分開。

options.text: The friends had quarrelled and ended their friendship—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
options.reasonZh: 沒有爭吵或絕交的證據。

items.promptEn: While her grandmother stayed in hospital, a girl remembered her stories daily and valued their time together more.
items.promptZh: 祖母住院期間，孫女每天想起她以前講的故事，越發珍惜相處的日子。

options.text: The girl valued her grandmother even more while they were apart—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
options.reasonZh: 故事與更珍惜的感受，支持因分開而更掛念。

options.text: The girl no longer remembered her grandmother’s stories—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
options.reasonZh: 原文說她每天想起故事。

options.text: The girl visited her grandmother at home every day—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
options.reasonZh: 原文說祖母住院，不是每天在家見面。

options.text: The hospital stay proved that every family grows closer—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
options.reasonZh: 一個家庭情況不能證明所有家庭如此。

items.promptEn: Two sisters work in different cities and treasure their holiday visits more than they used to.
items.promptZh: 兩位姊妹在不同城市工作，假日見面時更加珍惜彼此。

options.text: The sisters treasure their visits more because they live apart—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
options.reasonZh: 分居兩城與更珍惜見面有清楚聯繫。

options.text: The sisters see each other every day at work—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
options.reasonZh: 兩人在不同城市工作，不是每日見面。

options.text: The sisters now dislike spending holidays together—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
options.reasonZh: 原文說更加珍惜見面。

options.text: Living apart guarantees that no sisters will ever argue—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
options.reasonZh: 掛念增加不保證姊妹永不爭執。

items.promptEn: After half a term in a school hostel, Jun was more willing than before to listen to his younger brother at home.
items.promptZh: 阿俊在校外宿舍住了半學期，回家時比以前更願意聽弟弟說話。

options.text: Time away helped Jun appreciate conversations with his younger brother—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
options.reasonZh: 分開後更願意聆聽，屬感情變化。

options.text: Time away made Jun ignore his younger brother—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
options.reasonZh: 原文是更願意聽，不是忽略。

options.text: Jun had remained at home throughout the term—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
options.reasonZh: 阿俊在宿舍住了半學期。

options.text: Jun’s brother had moved into the hostel with him—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
options.reasonZh: 原文沒有說弟弟也入住。

items.promptEn: During a tournament abroad, Ying began to miss training with her coach more than she expected.
items.promptZh: 阿瑩到外國參賽後，開始更想念與教練一起練習的時間。

options.text: Ying missed training with her coach while she was away—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
options.reasonZh: 參賽期間更想念教練，符合情境。

options.text: Ying was glad never to train with her coach again—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
options.reasonZh: 與想念練習的事實相反。

options.text: Ying’s coach travelled abroad with her—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
options.reasonZh: 原文沒有說教練同行。

options.text: Every athlete becomes fond of every coach while travelling—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
options.reasonZh: 不能擴大到所有運動員與教練。

items.promptEn: A couple live apart temporarily; both say their reunion dinners feel more precious than before.
items.promptZh: 夫妻暫時分住兩地，兩人都說重聚的晚餐比以前珍貴。

options.text: Both partners value their dinners more during the separation—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
options.reasonZh: 兩人都說晚餐更珍貴，並有分開背景。

options.text: Both partners now avoid their reunion dinners—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
options.reasonZh: 與兩人更珍惜晚餐相反。

options.text: They have lived together without any separation—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
options.reasonZh: 原文說暫時分住兩地。

options.text: Their dinners have become more expensive for everyone—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
options.reasonZh: 珍貴指感情價值，不是價格上漲。

items.promptEn: After moving to another district, Di looked forward to weekend visits with his childhood friend more.
items.promptZh: 阿迪搬到另一區後，更期待週末見兒時好友。

options.text: Di looked forward to seeing his old friend more after moving—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
options.reasonZh: 搬遠後更盼見面，顯示掛念增加。

options.text: Di forgot the old friend after moving—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
options.reasonZh: 原文是更期待見面，不是淡忘。

options.text: Di moved into the same building as the old friend—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
options.reasonZh: 搬到另一區不等於住同一幢樓。

options.text: The friend stopped visiting Di because of a quarrel—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
options.reasonZh: 沒有爭吵的線索。

items.promptEn: After a year away from her hometown, Sze valued her parents’ messages more than she had before.
items.promptZh: 阿詩離開家鄉一年後，比以往更珍惜父母寄來的短訊。

options.text: Sze came to value her parents’ messages more during her year away—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
options.reasonZh: 分開後更珍惜短訊，正是感情加深的證據。

options.text: Sze received no messages from her parents during the year—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
options.reasonZh: 原文說父母有寄短訊。

options.text: Sze valued her parents’ messages less than before—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
options.reasonZh: 與「更珍惜」相反。

options.text: The year away proved that all families communicate perfectly—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
options.reasonZh: 更珍惜不證明所有家庭溝通完美。

items.promptEn: After five days at camp, a boy said he wanted to play chess with his grandfather more often.
items.promptZh: 男孩在露營五天後說，自己現在更想陪外公下棋。

options.text: The boy missed chess with his grandfather while away at camp—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
options.reasonZh: 分開後更想相處，符合諺語。

options.text: The boy decided never to play chess again—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
options.reasonZh: 原文是更想下棋，不是停止。

options.text: The grandfather spent all five days at camp with him—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
options.reasonZh: 題目沒有說外公參加露營。

options.text: The boy won every chess game after camp—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
options.reasonZh: 題目沒有交代勝負。

items.promptEn: Working away from home made Lok realise she valued her friend’s regular letters more than before.
items.promptZh: 阿樂在外地工作後，才發現自己比以前更珍惜朋友定期來信。

options.text: Lok valued her friend’s letters more after moving away—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
options.reasonZh: 分開後更珍惜來信，支持此用法。

options.text: Lok stopped reading her friend’s letters after moving away—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
options.reasonZh: 原文沒有說停止閱讀。

options.text: Lok and her friend had never been separated—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
options.reasonZh: 外地工作表示有距離。

options.text: Regular letters prove that separation is always pleasant—absence makes the heart grow fonder.
options.reasonZh: 定期來信不等於分離一定愉快。

meaning.zh: 與在乎的人分開一段時間後，可能因為掛念而更珍惜對方。
meaning.en: Time apart can make someone miss and value a loved person more.

model.zh: 阿澄去外地實習後，反而更期待每週與祖母通話。
model.en: While Cheng was away on placement, she looked forward to her weekly calls with her grandmother even more—absence makes the heart grow fonder.

picture.zh: 兩人相隔一段路；距離讓其中一人更清楚感到對方的重要。
picture.en: Imagine two people on opposite sides of a road: time apart makes one more aware of the other’s value.

boundary.zh: 分開不保證感情加深；要有「更掛念或更珍惜」的線索。
boundary.en: Separation alone is insufficient: the scene must show increased affection or longing.

where.zh: 適合談親友或伴侶暫時分開後更思念對方；不要用它催促別人接受不想要的分離。
where.en: Use it for growing fondness during a temporary separation, not to dismiss someone’s distress about being apart.

tone.zh: 通常溫暖、帶安慰意味；也可能只是描述個人的感受。
tone.en: Usually warm or reassuring; it can also be a simple personal observation.

checks.zh: 哪個細節顯示掛念增加？
我有把可能性說成必然嗎？
checks.en: Am I turning a possibility into a rule?

readAloud.zh: 哥哥離家讀書後，我們更珍惜每月一起吃晚飯的時間。
readAloud.en: Since my brother moved away for college, our monthly dinners have meant more to us—absence makes the heart grow fonder.

prompt.zh: 哪個情境真正支持這句諺語？

options.zh: 她離家三週後，比以前更期待聽到父親的聲音。
options.en: After three weeks away, she longs to hear her father’s voice more than before.
options.reasonZh: 分開與掛念增加都有交代。

options.zh: 她離家三週，卻沒有說自己對父親的感受。
options.en: She has been away for three weeks; nothing is said about her feelings for her father.
options.reasonZh: 只有距離，沒有感情變化的證據。

options.zh: 她每天都與父親同住，兩人仍然親近。
options.en: She still lives with her father and they remain close.
options.reasonZh: 親近不等於因分開而更掛念。

prompt.zh: 朋友因暫時分開而難過，哪個回應比較體貼？
prompt.en: A friend is upset about a temporary separation. Which reply is considerate?

options.zh: 「你很想念她；我們可以一起安排下次見面。」
options.en: “You miss her. Shall we plan when you can meet again?”
options.reasonZh: 先承認感受，再提供實際支持。

options.zh: 「小別勝新婚，所以你根本不用難過。」
options.en: “Absence makes the heart grow fonder, so you have no reason to feel sad.”
options.reasonZh: 諺語不能否定對方當下的難過。

options.zh: 「既然你想念她，就證明所有分離都有好處。」
options.en: “Because you miss her, every separation must be good.”
options.reasonZh: 個人的感受不能證明所有分離都有益。

prompt.zh: 兩個朋友分開後更珍惜重聚。哪一句最自然？
prompt.en: Two friends value their reunions more after living apart. Which line sounds natural?

options.zh: 「我們現在更期待見面；看來小別勝新婚。」
options.en: “We look forward to seeing each other even more now—absence makes the heart grow fonder.”
options.reasonZh: 說出重聚更受珍惜的變化。

options.zh: 「我們從沒分開過；看來小別勝新婚。」
options.en: “We have never been apart—absence makes the heart grow fonder.”
options.reasonZh: 沒有分開，缺少諺語的必要條件。

options.zh: 「我們分開後完全忘了對方；看來小別勝新婚。」
options.en: “We forgot each other completely while apart—absence makes the heart grow fonder.”
options.reasonZh: 淡忘與更掛念相反。

prompt.zh: 哪個說法沒有超出諺語的意思？
prompt.en: Which claim stays within the proverb’s meaning?

options.zh: 「對某些人而言，暫別可能令感情更深。」
options.en: “For some people, time apart may deepen affection.”
options.reasonZh: 保留了個人差異與可能性。

options.zh: 「只要分開，感情一定會變得更深。」
options.en: “Whenever people separate, their affection must grow.”
options.reasonZh: 把常見可能性誤說成必然。

options.zh: 「彼此不聯絡，就一定能修好任何關係。」
options.en: “No contact is guaranteed to repair any relationship.”
options.reasonZh: 諺語沒有保證修復關係。
